data.notes_barbara:
Partial HR product overlap; Overlapping HR buyers; Different core offering

Upland FileBound supports hiring, onboarding and employee-document workflows, creating overlap with Paylocity’s HR tools. Its broader portfolio does not provide the same core payroll/HCM offering, so it is adjacent.
data.notes_matthew: Upland is a collection of document and marketing workflow tools sold to IT (information technology) and marketing teams. No payroll or human resources product.

data.reason: Enterprise work management and content software for enterprises and government, with no payroll or HR focus.
Enterprise work management and content software; no payroll or HR focus, different customers and products.

Both sell cloud subscription software to businesses, but the products differ. Paylocity sells an HCM suite for payroll, HR, tax filing and spend management. Upland sells a portfolio of 20+ enterprise tools for knowledge search, RFP and proposal automation, email marketing, support answers and cloud fax. They share no product category. The buyers also differ: Paylocity sells to HR and finance teams at SMB and mid-sized employers, while Upland sells to enterprise sales, marketing, IT and knowledge teams. The only link is generic cloud software subscriptions.

Upland's knowledge tools support internal IT support teams, overlapping Paylocity's IT service support customers and functions. Its broader offering focuses on knowledge, sales and marketing rather than HCM.
